package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

// LearningWorkspaceSnapshotReader returns one read-only, repeatable Student
// projection. The repository must bind the selected ACTIVE path to the same
// student and context before returning it.
type LearningWorkspaceSnapshotReader interface {
	ReadLearningWorkspace(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource, error)
}
